Sekhiya 65 of the Bhikkhu Vibhaṅga, titled *Pallatthika* ("Clasping the knees"), is a training rule on proper monastic deportment found in the Vinaya Piṭaka. The text has been translated into English by Bhikkhu Brahmali.

 Extensive cross-tradition parallels are attested across other early Buddhist Vinayas, including the Vibhaṅgas and Prātimokṣa sūtras of the Sarvāstivāda, Mūlasarvāstivāda, Mahīśāsaka, Mahāsāṅghika, and Lokottaravāda schools preserved in Chinese (e.g., Sarvāstivāda Sk 95; Mahāsāṅghika Sk 55, *Nokkuṭikaṁ nisinnassa*), Sanskrit texts and fragments, and Tibetan translations (e.g., Mūlasarvāstivāda Sk 88).
